headline: Weathered Expanse Flares Anew as Fierce Fighting Grips Northern Hexes
war_summary: Weathered Expanse has abruptly shattered its brief lull, reigniting with thirteen base exchanges over the past two hours and leaving three strategic positions desolate in no-man’s-land as fighting surges around Crow’s Nest and Wightwalk. Mooring County remains locked in grueling contention, logging nine base transitions and over three thousand casualties across the two-hour window, with Colonial losses mounting around The Wind Hills and Wiccwalk. Concurrently, Callum’s Cape has witnessed a sharp return of severe bloodletting; casualty tallies there accelerated past twenty-two hundred in two hours alongside an influx of fresh recruits contesting Naofa and Callum's Keep. In Linn of Mercy, territorial instability persists unabated, registering eight base flips within two hours at Outwich Ranch and Lathair, despite comparatively modest casualty numbers. Secondary battlegrounds have largely tapered into stillness, with Marban Hollow recording no shifts following earlier fighting at Checkpoint Bua, and Dead Lands witnessing elevated Warden losses without territorial adjustment. Strategic focus for the coming day hinges upon these volatile northern sectors, where rapid base transfers threaten to redraw the contested frontier.
